unknown: This number is not enabled for Parts Relay. Ask your parts supplier to add it.
format:
Send me the vehicle registration plate and the parts you need, as a text, a photo or a voice message.

For example:
GH482KL oil filter air filter
summary: Ready to search {plate} · {query}. Reply YES to start the search, or tell me what to change.
unavailable: We couldn't read your request right now. Please send it again in a few minutes.
caption: {category} · {unit}
empty: {category}: no parts found for this vehicle.
vehicle-not-found: We couldn't identify the vehicle {plate}. Check the registration plate and send the request again.
not-matched: {vehicle} identified, but no part category matches your request. Send it again with a more specific part name, for example "oil filter".
failed: We couldn't complete the search for {plate}. The service is temporarily unavailable. Please send the request again in a few minutes.
